description: Full GAFF2 atom types for bonded parameters (RDKit SMARTS, first match, mapped :1; conjugated pair types written with the first name, the second assigned by alternation along Kekule bonds), the BOND/ANGL sections of gaff2.dat (K in kcal/mol/A^2 or kcal/mol/rad^2, E = K (x - x0)^2) and its general X-b-c-X torsions ([IDIVF, PK, phase, periodicity] per term, E = PK/IDIVF (1 + cos(n phi - phase)); source line last). Generated by src/scripts/build_gaff2_bonded.py.
source: gaff2.dat: AMBER General Force Field for organic molecules (Version 2.2.30, Oct 2025)
